name: Icon
description: A line icon from the MCSS-Lite sprite, drawn with a 2px stroke in the current text color.

values.name: sm
values.description: 16px, for dense text and small buttons.

children: Exactly one <use href="#mcss-icon-<name>">; the names are listed under Icons in AGENTS.md.

whenToUse: Next to a label, to help people scan: a download button, an external link.
Inside a severity tile in `c-alert`, where each tone has its own shape.
An icon-only button, with an accessible name on the button.
whenNotToUse: As the only way to show meaning when a word would do: write the word.
For decoration that repeats a nearby label; leave it out.
use: Inline the sprite once per page, then reference symbols by id.
Let the icon inherit the text color; change color on the parent.
avoid: Linking the sprite from a CDN: browsers block <use> across origins.
Coloring icons blue for decoration: blue means "act".

do.text: Hide a decorative icon from screen readers; the button text names the action.
do.html:
<button type="button" class="c-button">
  <svg class="c-icon" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><use href="#mcss-icon-download"></use></svg>
  Download the invoice
</button>

dont.text: Don't leave an icon exposed and unnamed: screen readers announce an unlabelled image, or nothing.

do.text: Give an icon-only button its name with aria-label.
do.html:
<button type="button" class="c-button" aria-label="Copy the API key">
  <svg class="c-icon" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><use href="#mcss-icon-copy"></use></svg>
</button>

dont.text: Don't invent icon names: an unknown symbol draws nothing.

a11y: Meaningful icons with no visible text: role="img" and aria-label on the <svg>.
Severity must never rely on an icon alone; pair it with text.
